body:
Maps existing bounded repertoire move verification and read-only source storage on the Study control census dependency. Records legal replay, cursor and source-token recheck without changing behavior. The census remains partial.

Validation: component checker and four scoped ownership/discovery controls passed using existing task-owned dependencies; no build or service was started. No dedicated test directly naming this verification service was found. Previously reported fixture gaps remain unresolved. Native and live behavior were not qualified.

## Summary by Sourcery

Map repertoire move verification ownership and source storage in the component census while preserving existing behavior.

Enhancements:
- Map repertoire move verification and its read-only source storage into the component census ownership model.
- Extend census discovery and ownership tests to cover the new repertoire move verification scope and prevent its ownership mapping from disappearing.

Documentation:
- Document the added repertoire move verification census selection and its remaining validation limitations.

Tests:
- Add component census coverage for repertoire move verification file discovery and ownership validation.
